title: Board Basis Contracted for Each Hotel Rate Plan
content:
What a nightly rate in the Hotel Rate Plans range includes by way of meals, and what is charged where it does not, is fixed by the plan booked.

| Rate plan | Breakfast in the nightly rate | Breakfast, per person per day | Dinner in the nightly rate | Meals, soft drinks and listed activities all included |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no | 28.00 USD | no | no |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | no | 26.00 USD | no | no |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no | 24.00 USD | no | no |
| Standard Flexible Rate | yes | 0.00 USD | no | no |
| Member Flex Rate | yes | 0.00 USD | no | no |
| Suite Flexible Rate | yes | 0.00 USD | no | no |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 0.00 USD | yes | yes |

The second column records whether breakfast is included in the nightly rate; the third is the charge for breakfast per person per day where it is not. The fourth records whether dinner is included in the nightly rate, and the fifth whether meals, soft drinks and listed activities are all included.

**Points of judgement.** Three plans of the range carry no breakfast in the rate and therefore a standing breakfast amount: the Non-Refundable Saver Rate at 28.00 USD, the Advance Purchase 21 Rate at 26.00 USD and the Semi-Flexible Rate at 24.00 USD. One plan alone, the All-Inclusive Flex Rate, carries dinner in the rate and is contracted as fully inclusive; on the other six the fourth and fifth columns both read no.
